test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Callous
solution:
The correct answer is '**caring'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Callous** means feeling or showing no sympathy for others.

 
 
• Example- He seemed **callous** when he delivered the horrible news.
 
 
 
• **Caring** means feeling or showing concern or kindness for others.
 
 
• Example- Mary is the most caring person you will ever meet.
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**callous**' and '**caring**' are opposite in meaning. Therefore the correct answer is '**caring**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cold** means lacking affection or warmth of feelings.
 
• **Insensitive** means showing or feeling no concern for others' feelings.
 
• **Hardened** means someone who has had so many bad experiences that nothing upsets or shocks them anymore.
